Thanks for the debug info — I pulled the webhook logs. Relevant snippet: 

[2027-02-26T13:03:21Z] webhook.wh_9f7b2a received for acct_0NVA3 payload:{promo:EARLYBIRD-50, idempotency_key: signup_0NVA3_v1}
[2027-02-26T13:03:22Z] ledger.create attempted with idempotency_key: signup_0NVA3_v1 -> ERROR: idempotency mismatch (existing key signup-0NVA3-v1)
[2027-02-26T13:03:22Z] webhook.wh_9f7b2a processed, response: 200 OK

We have two semantically equivalent idempotency keys in different formats (underscore vs dash), which caused the create to be skipped even though the first attempt never completed the ledger row. The webhook handler returned 200 to avoid retries.

Plan:
1) Engineering will insert a single ledger row (amount: 50 credits) with metadata: {source: "manual-backfill", note: "SUP-1129 backfill for wh_9f7b2a"}
2) Emit credits_granted event so UI recalculates balance
3) Patch webhook handler to normalize idempotency keys (underscore <-> dash) and add an explicit verify-before-ack path to avoid silent drops.

I will run the backfill at 2027-02-27T11:00:00-08:00 and post results.

— Dev
